verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch documents secret variables in environments (masked secrets, kept separate from shared collection files) and enterprise-tier SSO/on-prem controls, but there is no evidence of an external vault integration (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager) or independent verification that secret masking is robust. missing for 10: external vault integration, third-party/hands-on confirmation of secret-masking effectiveness.
